subtitle: Learn words while you chat
short_description: Chat with friends and learn words as they switch between two languages.
description:
Chat with friends. Learn words as you read.

Vipi is a messaging app that helps you learn words through conversations with friends. Selected words and short phrases repeatedly switch in place between the original language and the language you choose. The rest of the message keeps its original wording, word order and grammar.

See an example before signing in
Try the English and Spanish example to see the words change. This example demonstrates the feature; it does not mean every word in your chats can change. Available vocabulary is limited and varies by language. Unsupported words and phrases stay unchanged.

Read at your own pace
Pause the changes, show the original message, or tap Listen to hear pronunciation. Choose how much of each message you want to switch. Reading guides show words in Latin letters where supported. Available voices and guides depend on your language and downloads.

Learn from conversations you care about
See words in your plans, questions and everyday chats. Vipi does not provide lessons or promise fluency.
